name: How long does a typical residential flooring installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical residential flooring installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a residential flooring installation depends on several factors, including the type of flooring, the size of the area, and any necessary subfloor preparation. For instance, a basic laminate or LVP installation in a standard-sized room might take 1-2 days, while a complex tile or hardwood project spanning multiple rooms could extend to 3-5 days or more. We provide a detailed project timeline after an on-site assessment to give you an accurate estimate for your home in areas like Pacifica or Daly City.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies based on flooring type, area size, and preparation, typically ranging from 1-5 days. A detailed timeline is provided after assessment.
